# PubPeer Register

<!-- GENERATED FILE. Do not edit by hand. Regenerate with `uv run --no-dev python projects/RETRACTIONS/check_pubpeer.py`. -->

Every `PMID:` cited in the gene reviews, checked for PubPeer discussion. Generated 2026-10-25 from **7111** review files; **45511** of 45511 distinct cited PMIDs checked, **1070** have PubPeer comments. See the [project page](../RETRACTIONS.md) for method.

**A comment count is not a verdict.** PubPeer threads range from image-duplication reports to routine questions; a listed paper has been discussed, and nothing more is implied until someone reads the thread.

## PubPeer reports a formal notice that PubMed does not

PubPeer relays publisher retractions and expressions of concern. These are papers where it shows one that PubMed does not. **Verify the notice before acting**: PubPeer can attach a notice to the wrong paper by matching a publisher article number rather than the PMID (the 2026-10-25 run's one case was such a mismatch).
